title: Rigetti Establishes Dedicated Systems Delivery Organization to Scale On-Premises Deployments - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Rigetti Computing has split its operations into a dedicated Systems Delivery organization for commercial on-premises deployments and a separate Technology organization focused on core hardware R&D, while targeting 99.5% two-qubit gate fidelity on its 108-qubit Cepheus platform.

insights.claim: Rigetti Computing, Inc. (Nasdaq: RGTI) has reorganized into a dedicated Systems Delivery organization handling manufacturing, commercial sales, and customer-facing engineering, separate from a streamlined Technology organization that consolidates all hardware engineering and chiplet development.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The structural separation of commercial delivery from core R&D signals Rigetti is scaling toward more commercial deployments requiring dedicated operational bandwidth, a maturity signal for investors evaluating RGTI's commercialization stage.
insights.locator: Superconducting quantum hardware developer Rigetti Computing

insights.claim: Historically, customer installation and field support were handled directly within Rigetti's core engineering group; the reorganization isolates commercial delivery logistics from hardware research so the R&D team can focus exclusively on processor fidelity and roadmap execution.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Suggests Rigetti believes shared ownership of delivery and R&D was slowing technical progress, a common growing pain that, if resolved, could speed processor development cadence.
insights.locator: Scaling On-Premises Deployments and Isolating R&D

insights.claim: The new Systems Delivery unit will manage scaling and deployment for on-premises hardware ranging from the 9-qubit Novera QPU to 36-qubit systems and large-scale 108-qubit Cepheus-class systems deployed at national laboratories and quantum computing centers.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Indicates a growing installed base and diversified product tiers, a proxy for near-term hardware revenue potential investors can track quarter over quarter.

insights.claim: Manufacturing operations at Rigetti's Fab-1 facility in Berkeley, California will now align directly with the Systems Delivery arm to streamline assembly, testing, and delivery schedules.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Vertical integration of fab and delivery could shorten lead times for customer installs, a factor in Rigetti's competitiveness for near-term contracts.

insights.claim: Rigetti's Technology organization remains focused on achieving a benchmark target of 99.5% median two-qubit (CZ) gate fidelity on its Cepheus-1-108Q platform, a 108-qubit QPU built by tiling twelve 9-qubit chiplets together with inter-module couplers.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Gate fidelity is the key technical KPI investors should track each quarter to judge whether Rigetti's multi-chip tiling approach is closing the performance gap with larger superconducting competitors.
